x: In sunny conditions over 150 runners tackled the slopes of Brockwell Park and soon it was the Hounslow pair of Mohamed Farah and Ben Whitby, together with Herne Hill's Dave Taylor who were making the running.
After eight reps, real exhaustion smothers you. “This is that part of the session where the bowels start to give way,” Ben Whitby once grimly remarked.

Phil Wicks was far and away the strongest individual, winning by 42 seconds from Ben Whitby (Herne Hill) and Phil Sly (Thames H&H). Will Cockerell was 11th but with other leading Belgravians resting up for the following day's National 10k Champs at Chichester ... and Richard Stannard unable to find…
Major and McMullen pushed hard for Thames on the first circuit but Ben Whitby was only biding his time and he came away for a clear Herne Hill individual victory.
